research.title: Oscar Sort Waste Sorting Data Analysis

bullets.text: Analyzed large-scale waste disposal dataset from computer vision–enabled recycling bins to assess sorting accuracy trends and contamination causes with mentorship from Professor Yash Babar
Applied statistical methods (correlation analysis, weighted regression, association rule mining) to identify priority waste items and create actionable insights
Created visualizations and a final report for the UW–Madison Office of Sustainability to summarize my findings and inform sustainability strategy
